claims.value: Two deed-restricted affordable ADUs at 700 Monte Vista Ln; an affordable housing agreement must be recorded before building permits (Condition B2). Measure D transfer allocations were awarded on the basis that the project would include two affordable units.

claims.note: Coastal Development Permit and Architectural Review by the Community Development Director

construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

Staff report: 700 Monte Vista (17,780 sq ft flag lot) converts the existing 5,219 sq ft commercial building to a duplex with a 250 sq ft addition, adds a two-story detached structure with two two-car garages, a 400 sq ft ground-floor efficiency ADU and a 749 sq ft two-bedroom ADU above; 704 Monte Vista (6,000 sq ft lot) gets a new one-story 1,464 sq ft single-family home with an attached 719 sq ft ADU. Zoning C-R, land use C-G; CEQA exempt under Section 15303.
Staff report parking: 700 Monte Vista provides 4 covered and 7 uncovered spaces; 704 Monte Vista provides 1 covered and 1 uncovered.

The state report's 2025 entitlement rows split the six units as two ADUs and a two-unit building at 700 Monte Vista Lane and one single-family home and one ADU at 704 Monte Vista Lane, all approved 2025-12-10; the two-unit row notes 2 units deed restricted.
Plan set title block: plans designed and drawn by Bob Williamson, owner/builder.
